Install with an AI assistant

Use the prompt to install and verify Sweep TV. Once it opens, follow the first-time setup guide on your TV.

Requires Android TV or Google TV on Android 8.0 or newer, with APK installation allowed.

  1. Enable wireless debugging on the TV. Follow the wireless debugging guide.
  2. Open your assistant. Use Claude Code, Codex, or another assistant. A local coding assistant can run the commands on your computer. A chat assistant can walk you through them.
  3. Paste the setup prompt. Keep the TV remote nearby to approve the debugging connection when asked.

Where the assistant gets Sweep TV

The prompt sends your assistant to the project’s GitHub Releases page. The prompt asks your assistant to verify the signed preview against its published checksum before installing. You can also review the source on GitHub.
